typography.instructions: Use Inter for all primary UI elements, headings, and body text. Strictly use DM Mono for all IDs, dates, numbers, invoice amounts, and time tracking logs.

main_content.spacing: ml-[220px] pt-[54px] min-h-screen bg-[#F4F6F9] p-6 md:p-8

components.tags_badges: Always pill-shaped (rounded-full). Match background color (10-15% opacity) and text color to the status or client brand.
components.tables: Clean, flat tables with sticky headers. Use DM Mono for tabular numeric data.
components.modals: Dialog backdrop should be bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-sm. Modals have 12px radius. Job details must include a 5-stage workflow diagram horizontally at the top.
components.cards: White surfaces, 12px border-radius, 1px solid #E5E8F0, very subtle shadow.
components.kanban_board: Columns should have grey backgrounds (e.g., bg-slate-50) with white cards inside. Ensure cards are draggable or visually imply drag capability.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Example: data-testid='sidebar-dashboard-link'.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure sufficient contrast for all text over pill backgrounds.

media.images_behavior: Avatars should be perfectly circular with a subtle inner ring. Hero/banners must be contained properly with object-cover.

vibes_banner.description: Diverse group of adults in a modern office. Used for the /vibes motivation banner.

libraries.charts: recharts (for KPI rings, bar charts, line graphs)

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's explicit color codes for backgrounds, borders, and clients.
Use standard React (.jsx/.js) files. DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx/.ts).
Ensure the sidebar navigation accurately maps all 15 routes.
The Smart Inbox page must feature an AI Brief Parser modal heavily highlighted in the UI.
Build the KPI page with SVG score rings using Recharts or custom SVGs.
Do NOT center align the main application wrapper. Keep text alignment natural (left).
Never use a completely transparent background for headers, dropdowns, or modals.
Apply `data-testid` to buttons, links, form inputs, and major containers.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle shadows, but keep it professional and clean for an internal dashboard.
Avoid generic, 'on-distribution' AI slop. Make the internal tool feel premium and lightning-fast.
Include hover states and micro-interactions on all actionable elements without breaking layout.
Do not use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
